newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit gains sharply seen rising further in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit gains sharply seen rising further in Europe.

text.p: The ringgit rose sharply through the day on sustained buying against the Singapore dollar, and expectations of further demand in London and New York trading hours, dealers said on Monday.
They said higher interest rates in Malaysia, a sharply improved trade balance figure, and movement from Sing to ringgit was helping the Malaysian unit.
"For now, more ringgit buyings could be on the cards when Europe players enter the market," said research firm I.D.E.A.
It said rumour of Malaysia's current account deficit, being revised down due to better trade data, was aiding the currency.
